title: The Customer Who Never Came Back
hook: Your customer didn't complain. They just stopped buying.
script: Your customer didn't complain. They just stopped buying. That's what makes poor service dangerous: sometimes you never hear the reason. Picture a customer asking for an update on an order. Nobody replies. They wait, then quietly choose another seller. Here's a habit that helps: record every order, assign someone to follow up, and send updates before customers have to chase you. A good product may win the first sale. Clear communication helps earn the next one.
editorial_notes: Hypothetical example. Balanced voice rotation. Renderer uses generic frames, not scene-specific visuals.
